## Ecstasy Feeder (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
NE Medium aberration  
 **Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +10 **Aura** aura of hunger (30 ft., DC 15)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 16, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +2 armor, +1 natural)  
 **hp** 44 (4d8+12)  
 **Fort** +3, **Ref** +4, **Will** +5  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** 2 claws +6 (1d6+3 plus ecstasy toxin plus grab)  
 **Special Attacks** feeding grapple  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 12, **Dex** 17, **Con** 14, **Int** 13, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 17  
 **Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +6 (+10 grapple); **CMD** 17  
 **Feats** Toughness, Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +11, Bluff +10, Escape Artist +11, Perception +10, Stealth +11  
 **Language** Common, Undercommon  

**Special Abilities**

 **Aura of Hunger (Su)** An ecstasy feeder feels a constant vicious hunger so strong that it fills the minds of those around the feeder as well. All living creatures within a 30-foot radius feel intense, unnatural hunger; those that fail a Will save (DC 15) spend a move action on their turn gnawing on their own flesh to sate this hunger, dealing 1 point of Con damage to themselves. A new saving throw may be made at the beginning of each round for as long as the creature remains in the aura. The save DC is Charisma-based. Ecstasy feeders are immune to the effects of other ecstasy feeders’ auras. An ecstasy feeder can spend a swift action to suppress its aura of hunger for 1 round.  

 **Ecstasy Toxin (Ex)** Claw—injury; *save* Fort DC 16, *frequency* 1/round for 6 rounds, *effect* 1d2 Cha, *cure* 1 save. The save DC is Constitutuion-based and includes a +2 racial bonus. This toxic causes waves of intense pleasure to radiate from the wound. While a creature is suffering from Cha damage from this poison, it also suffers a –2 penalty to AC and CMD against the ecstasy feeder as it unconsciously lets its guard down. Those who succumb to the poison feel no pain from the feeder’s claws, and thus a target who is not hostile toward the feeder may not realize it is under attack.  

 **Feeding Grapple (Ex)** On a successful grapple check against a living creature, the ecstasy feeder deals 1 Con damage to its target.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any warm or urban  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** standard (leather armor)
